label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Priya,

Taking this off the main thread so it's just us.

Thank you for saying it straight. I'm not throwing you under the bus with Greg. The questionnaire library is a mess and nobody owns it, so that old Q14 language was sitting there waiting for whoever pulled it next. That's what he's going to hear from me, along with the plan. He's going to be mad no matter what, and that part is mine to handle.

I also haven't forgotten September, when you stayed on until 9 rebuilding their demo environment after the route import broke. One copy-paste miss doesn't cancel that out, so please don't beat yourself up.

I won't pretend I'm calm about it. This is 186k ARR on a three-year term, I've been working it since February, and I already told my wife we'd finally do the Big Bend trip off the commission. So yes, I really want this one. I also think it's fixable if we're honest and fast. Dana seems strict but fair, and the real story isn't a bad one.

Here's where things stand. I talked to Marcus on the security team. The Type II audit window closes Jan 31 and the report is expected by March. He says we can give Brazos a bridge letter from the auditor in the meantime, and he can do a call with Dana and their legal team Thursday at 2.

Two things I need from you:

1. Fix Q14 tonight with the real status: Type I issued in April, Type II in progress, audit window closing Jan 31. Send it to me first, not Dana. Greg wants to talk before anything goes back to her.
2. Join the Thursday call. You know their setup better than anyone and I want you in the room.

We're fixing this together. Call me tonight if you want to talk any of it through.

Jordan

---

The line about what Greg will hear is my read of your notes, so change it if you plan to put it to him differently.
